title: Orchestr.AI: A Unified Workflow for Training and Benchmarking of Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
title_zh: Orchestr.AI：用于机器学习原子间势的训练和基准测试的统一工作流程
summary: 机器学习力场能够以接近参考的精度进行原子模拟，并大大降低了计算成本，但它们的开发仍然分散在软件框架中，数据格式、配置方案、依赖性和执行过程不兼容。 Orchestr.AI 通过统一的工作流程解决了这一限制，该工作流程协调不同的 MLIP 软件框架（称为引擎），用于数据准备、模型训练、微调、评估和部署。通用的 YAML 接口定义每个实验，而特定于引擎的环境配置文件保留兼容的软件堆栈并避免依赖冲突。
abstract: arXiv:2611.13898v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learning force fields enable atomistic simulations at near-reference accuracy and substantially reduced computational cost, but their development remains fragmented across software frameworks with incompatible data formats, configuration schemes, dependencies, and execution procedures. Orchestr.AI addresses this limitation through a unified workflow that coordinates different MLIP software frameworks, referred to as engines, for data preparation, model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and deployment. A common YAML interface defines each experiment, while engine-specific environment profiles preserve compatible software stacks and avoid dependency conflicts. The platform currently supports five MLIP model architectures, namely SchNet, PaiNN, NequIP, Allegro, and MACE, through their corresponding software implementations, providing automated configuration mapping and standardized dataset handling across these frameworks. Benchmarks on the rMD17 and 3BPA datasets show that Orchestr.AI reproduces the expected performance trends while enabling controlled cross-engine comparisons. Repeated executions with fixed configurations and engine profiles produce highly consistent results, demonstrating practical workflow reproducibility. Beyond training, Orchestr.AI provides modular architectural interfaces that connect trained models to ASE-based simulations, batch inference, epistemic uncertainty estimation, calibration, and active-learning workflows. The platform therefore provides a reproducible and extensible infrastructure for developing, comparing, and deploying machine-learning interatomic potentials, which we validate here through cross-engine accuracy and repeatability benchmarks.

title: Leveraging Large Language Models to Predict Atomic Oxygen Erosion of Polymers in Low Earth Orbit
title_zh: 利用大型语言模型预测近地轨道聚合物的原子氧侵蚀
summary: 近地轨道（LEO）是大多数活跃卫星的所在地，预计将经历称为凯斯勒综合症的碎片碎片级联。鉴于这种可能性，必须最大限度地延长低地球轨道卫星的使用寿命。实现这一目标的关键是开发具有更高抗原子氧（AO）侵蚀能力的下一代聚合物材料。由于真正的低地球轨道暴露实验非常昂贵，而且低地球轨道条件很难在实验室中重现，因此数据驱动的方法为加速材料发现提供了一种有前途的替代方案。
abstract: arXiv:2611.12910v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Low Earth orbit (LEO), home to most active satellites, is projected to undergo a debris-fragmentation cascade known as Kessler Syndrome. In light of this eventuality, it is imperative to maximize the operational lifetime of LEO satellites. Instrumental to this goal is the development of next-generation polymeric materials with improved resistance to atomic oxygen (AO) erosion. Because genuine LEO exposure experiments are prohibitively expensive and LEO conditions are difficult to reproduce in the laboratory, data-driven approaches offer a promising alternative for accelerating materials discovery. Here, we develop a fine-tuned large language model (LLM) based on OpenAI's GPT-4o to predict the AO erosion yield (E_y) of polymers using a curated dataset of 201 measurements compiled from multiple NASA LEO exposure missions. The model achieves an order of magnitude error (OME) of 0.154 and a log-scaled coefficient of determination (log-R²) of 0.719, outperforming conventional machine learning approaches while eliminating the need for extensive feature engineering. Notably, incorporating macroscopic descriptors such as film thickness and layering did not improve predictive performance, suggesting that AO erosion is governed primarily by chemical and environmental variables rather than bulk structural characteristics. This finding underscores the importance of chemically informed polymer design in developing materials with improved AO resistance, while demonstrating the ability of modern LLMs to effectively extract chemically meaningful relationships even when data is limited. Beyond its predictive accuracy, the proposed framework provides a scalable platform for rapidly screening candidate polymers, reducing reliance on costly spaceflight experiments.

title: Machine Learning-Enhanced Air Quality Management via QFIELD and QGIS: Mapping and Bio-cover Materials at Ojota Landfill
title_zh: 通过QFIELD和QGIS进行机器学习增强的空气质量管理： Ojota垃圾填埋场的测绘和生物覆盖材料
summary: 垃圾填埋场排放是发展中国家快速城市化城市面临的主要环境挑战。从管理不善的垃圾填埋场释放的甲烷、颗粒物和产生气味的化合物会导致空气污染，并对周围社区构成风险。本研究评估了实验室模拟生物覆盖系统的有效性，该系统使用6: 2: 1: 1混合比的垃圾填埋表土、堆肥、稻壳和蚯蚓粪便配制，以减轻尼日利亚拉各斯Ojota垃圾填埋场的微生物和气体排放。
abstract: Landfill emissions represent a major environmental challenge in rapidly urbanizing cities within developing countries. Methane, particulate matter, and odor-generating compounds released from poorly managed landfill sites contribute to air pollution and pose risks to surrounding communities. This study evaluates the effectiveness of a laboratory-simulated bio-cover system formulated using landfill topsoil, compost, rice husk and earthworm castings in a 6:2:1:1 mix ratio for mitigating microbial and gaseous emissions at the Ojota landfill in Lagos, Nigeria. Spatially informed field measurements are conducted at six sampling points established at 15m intervals across the landfill, coordinates recorded and mapped via QFIELD and QGIS to provide accurate spatial representation of emission gradients across the study area. Air quality parameters including particulate matter (PM2.5 and PM10), sulfur dioxide (SO₂), and carbon monoxide (CO) are monitored to establish baseline environmental conditions. To extend this point-based assessment, six machine learning approaches — Random Forest, Gradient Boosting (XGBoost/LightGBM), Support Vector Machine, K-Nearest Neighbours, Gaussian Process Regression/Regression Kriging, and an Artificial Neural Network — are applied to the geo-referenced air quality dataset to classify AQI status by pollutant driver and to generate a continuous, uncertainty-aware pollutant risk surface across the landfill footprint. Microbial indicators including total bacterial count (TBC), total coliform count (TCC), and fecal coliform (FC) are determined, while physicochemical characterization involves pH measurements and Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR) over soil samples collected. Results show significant reductions in microbial indicators following bio-cover application, improved biological regulation within the cover material, pH values remain within near-neutral conditions favorable for microbial oxidation processes. FTIR spectra further reveal functional groups associated with organic matter stabilization and biodegradation. The novelty of this study lies in integrating geospatial air quality mapping and machine learning-based prediction with microbiological and FTIR-based biochemical characterization to evaluate a locally formulated bio-cover system under tropical landfill conditions, providing a sustainable and cost-effective strategy for improving landfill air quality management.

title: Topological Dynamics Under Non-Stationary Supervision: Persistent Homology of Neural Network Weight Evolution
title_zh: 非平稳监督下的拓扑动力学：神经网络权值演化的持久同调
summary: 我们研究神经元权重点云的持久拓扑如何在稳定和非平稳的监督下演化。在 Fashion-MNIST 上训练相同的多层感知器，并使用正确的标签、训练标签向量的固定随机排列或每个时期的新排列。 5 个配对种子共享初始化和小批量顺序，产生 15 个经过 100 个 epoch 训练的模型。使用 22 个检查点的 H0 和 H1 Vietoris Rips 持久性对原始和行归一化传入重量云进行分析。正确标签模型平均真实标签测试准确率达到 89.39%；
abstract: arXiv:2611.13701v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate how the persistent topology of neuron- weight point clouds evolves under stable and non-stationary supervision. An identical multilayer perceptron is trained on Fashion-MNIST with correct labels, a fixed random permutation of the training-label vector, or a fresh permutation every epoch. Five paired seeds share initialisation and minibatch order, yielding 15 models trained for 100 epochs. Raw and row-normalised incoming weight clouds are analysed with H0 and H1 Vietoris Rips persistence at 22 checkpoints. Correct-label models reach 89.39% mean true-label test accuracy; fixed-random models fit 67.94% of their assigned training targets without generalising to the original task. Correct-label models have descriptively greater time-averaged normalised fc3 H1 persistence than either random-label condition, but the configured exact comparisons do not reach conventional significance after Holm correction. Early condition classification achieves 60.0% mean balanced accuracy using topology, 66.7% using conventional diagnostics, and 60.0% using both. Thus, no incremental predictive improvement is demonstrated in this setting. The archive contains all 3,300 configured topology cases. Interpretation is limited by five seeds, a single architecture and dataset, 282 capped H1 distance comparisons, and deferred bottleneck analysis.

title: A high-dimensional neural network potential for finite-temperature phenomena in NiTi martensite
title_zh: NiTi 马氏体有限温度现象的高维神经网络潜力
summary: 我们提出了一种针对 NiTi 形状记忆合金马氏体相的高维神经网络势 (HDNNP)，并根据密度泛函理论 (DFT) 数据进行了训练。这项工作的一个核心方面是对控制结构演化的关键特性（包括平衡晶体结构、弹性常数、广义堆垛层错能和振动谱）的基础 DFT 参考方法的潜力进行系统验证。 HDNNP 准确地描述了 B19^prime 和 B33 相的相对稳定性，包括 meV/原子数量级的细微能量差异。
abstract: arXiv:2607.20681v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a high-dimensional neural network potential (HDNNP) for the martensitic phase of the NiTi shape-memory alloy trained to density functional theory (DFT) data. A central aspect of this work is the systematic validation of the potential with respect to the underlying DFT reference method for key properties governing structural evolution, including equilibrium crystal structures, elastic constants, generalized-stacking fault energies, and vibrational spectra. The HDNNP accurately describes the relative stability of the B19^prime and B33 phases, including subtle energy differences on the order of meV/atom. The predicted stacking-fault energy landscape is strongly anisotropic and reveals a preferential shear pathway, providing atomistic insight into deformation and twinning mechanisms. Finite-temperature molecular dynamics simulations further enable the investigation of unconstrained structural evolution as a function of temperature. Overall, the developed HDNNP provides a robust basis for atomistic simulations of the complex structural and functional behavior of martensitic NiTi systems containing hundreds of thousands of atoms on nanosecond time scales.

title: Modeling the inner electric double layer using short-range machine learning potentials: A critical assessment
title_zh: 使用短程机器学习势对内部双电层进行建模：关键评估
summary: 电化学界面的原子模拟通常需要较大的系统尺寸和较长的模拟时间才能获得可靠的热力学性质。在这种情况下，与基于密度泛函理论的分子动力学模拟相比，机器学习原子间势（MLIP）可以实现计算上高效的采样。尽管传统的短程 MLIP 被认为不足以模拟（可能是纳米宽的）扩散层，但它们仍然能够描述与电化学反应相关的内部双电层。
abstract: Atomistic simulations of electrochemical interfaces typically require large system sizes and long simulation times to obtain reliable thermodynamic properties. In this context, machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) allow for computationally efficient sampling compared to density functional theory-based molecular dynamics simulations. Although conventional short-range MLIPs are recognized as inadequate for modeling the (potentially nanometer-wide) diffuse layer, they may still be capable of describing the inner electric double layer that is relevant for electrochemical reactions. Here, we evaluate the performance of common (short-ranged) MLIP architectures [the deep potential DP, the (graph) atomic cluster expansion-based models GRACE and MACE, and the pre-trained eSEN-OC25] for charged Au/electrolyte interfaces. In the evaluation, we focus on the effect of message passing and on the potentially adverse effect of data interference when training for a broad range of surface charges. Our results suggest that both local and message-passing models are able to reliably learn the interfacial structure when training on a single charge state. However, when trained on datasets that span multiple charge states, the MLIPs tested yield inconsistent predictions of interfacial water orientation and ion distributions. This behavior can be traced to the MLIPs being “blind” to the actual surface charge. Message-passing models show somewhat greater robustness to mixed-charge training data, likely due to their larger receptive field, but are still prone to artifacts and errors in the description of the interfacial structure. Overall, our results provide practical guidance on the expected accuracy and cross-charge-state transferability of short-ranged MLIPs for the description of the inner layer of electrode/electrolyte interfaces that will be relevant to their use in computational electrocatalysis.
journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

title: PINNverse meets Jordan--Wigner: learning the Hamiltonian of long spin chains
title_zh: PINNverse 遇上乔丹——维格纳：学习长自旋链的哈密顿量
summary: 逆物理信息神经网络 (PINNverse) 从测量的期望值中学习量子哈密顿量的参数，但网络输出随着量子位数量 N 的增加而增长为 4^N。我们表明，对于具有最近邻交换相互作用的自旋链，Jordan-Wigner 变换消除了这种指数成本：动力学在 N×N 单体密度矩阵上闭合，因此网络只需要 N² 输出，并且数据是在五个全局设置中测量的局部可观测量。寄生 ZZ 耦合（串扰）通过时间相关的 Hartree--Fock 闭包包含在内。
abstract: arXiv:2611.14023v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Inverse physics-informed neural networks (PINNverse) learn the parameters of a quantum Hamiltonian from measured expectation values, but the network output grows as 4^N with the number of qubits N. We show that, for spin chains with nearest-neighbor exchange interactions, the Jordan-Wigner transformation removes this exponential cost: the dynamics closes on an N× N one-body density matrix, so the network needs only N² outputs and the data are local observables measured in five global settings. Parasitic ZZ couplings (crosstalk) are included through a time-dependent Hartree--Fock closure. With synthetic data, the same network first solves the equation of motion and then recovers the Hamiltonian parameters of chains of up to 50 qubits, with couplings learned to better than 0.1%. Errors in the local frequencies of long chains are removed by a direct least-squares fit started from the network estimate.

title: How anion composition governs structural frameworks and Li-ion transport in oxychloride solid-state electrolytes
title_zh: 阴离子组成如何控制氯氧化物固态电解质中的结构框架和锂离子传输
summary: 混合阴离子氯氧化锂表现出高锂电导率，但氧含量、结构框架和锂离子传输之间的关系仍不清楚。在这里，使用机器学习原子间势的晶体结构预测和分子动力学模拟来检查 Li_yMOₓCl₆₋₂ₓ（M = Nb 和 Ta [第 5 族]，M = Ti、Zr 和 Hf [第 4 族]）。增加氧含量将孤立的富含氯化物的多面体转变为一维链，随后转变为更加高度连接的二维和三维框架。在第 5 族系列中，快速 Li 扩散发生在 x 约 0.67--1.5 范围内，其中 Li 位点形成三维渗透网络。
abstract: arXiv:2611.13611v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mixed-anion lithium oxychlorides exhibit high Li conductivity, but the relationship between oxygen content, structural framework, and Li-ion transport remains unclear. Here, crystal structure prediction and molecular dynamics simulations with machine-learning interatomic potentials are used to examine Li_yMOₓCl₆₋₂ₓ (M = Nb and Ta [Group 5] and M = Ti, Zr, and Hf [Group 4]). Increasing oxygen content changes isolated chloride-rich polyhedra into one-dimensional chains and subsequently more highly connected two- and three-dimensional frameworks. In the Group 5 series, fast Li diffusion occurs over x approx 0.67--1.5, where the Li sites form a three-dimensional percolating network. Potential of mean force maps and nudged elastic band calculations reveal that fast Li-ion transport requires a low-dimensional framework supporting long-range migration through undercoordinated Li sites with low barriers, together with similar energies across Li sites. Finally, we perform fine-grid compositional search, which identifies LiNbO₀.₆₇Cl₄.₆₇, LiTaO₀.₇₅Cl₄.₅, LiNbO₁.₅Cl₃, and LiTaO₁.₅Cl₃ as stable candidates with predicted room-temperature self-diffusivities of up to sim 10⁻⁶,cm²/s. These findings establish how oxygen content controls framework and Li-ion transport, guiding the design of lithium oxyhalide electrolytes.

title: Scalable Bayesian Optimization of Composite Functions for Image-Based Inverse Problems in Materials Characterization
title_zh: 材料表征中基于图像的反问题的复合函数的可扩展贝叶斯优化
summary: 根据科学图像估算物理参数是材料表征中常见的反问题，通常需要依靠昂贵的基于物理的模拟。在电子显微镜中，样品厚度和晶体误倾角是决定电子如何在样品中散射的关键参数，因此也是从样品中还原的任何原子级结构的准确性的关键参数。通常通过将实验的平均位置会聚束电子衍射（PACBED）图样与模拟图样进行匹配来推断这些图样，但网格搜索的扩展性较差，而神经网络方法需要大量的预训练，这些预训练可能无法迁移到新条件下。
abstract: arXiv:2609.02126v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Estimating physical parameters from scientific images is a common inverse problem in materials characterization that often relies on expensive physics-based simulations. In electron microscopy, specimen thickness and crystal mistilt are critical parameters that govern how electrons scatter through the sample, and therefore the accuracy of any atomic-scale structure recovered from it. They are commonly inferred by matching experimental position-averaged convergent-beam electron diffraction (PACBED) patterns to simulated ones, but grid searches scale poorly and neural-network methods require extensive pretraining that may not transfer to new conditions. Here, we propose scalable Bayesian optimization of composite functions (SBOCF), a simulation-efficient method that exploits the known composite structure of the image-matching objective and the intermediate information contained in simulated images. By representing PACBED images with patch-level summaries and two correction terms, SBOCF preserves the original pixel-wise objective while reducing the number of modeled outputs from 24,649 to 11. Under a budget of 50 simulator evaluations, SBOCF outperformed standard Bayesian optimization with expected improvement on synthetic SrTiO3 benchmarks with thick and thin specimens, reducing the median final SSE by up to 290 times in the thick-sample case. On experimental data, SBOCF produced parameter estimates consistent with previously reported values without task-specific pretraining. For a simulated mistilted specimen, using the SBOCF estimates in a downstream ptychographic reconstruction recovered sharp atoms that were otherwise blurred. These results establish SBOCF as a promising approach for inverse problems involving expensive simulators and high-dimensional structured outputs.

title: Geometry-Selective Higher-order topological insulators induced by dₓy altermagnet
title_zh: dₓy 交变磁体诱导的几何选择性高阶拓扑绝缘体
summary: 我们证明，接近 dₓy 波交变磁体为设计边界几何相关的高阶拓扑相提供了一条有效的途径。边界几何形状在确定拓扑特性中起着至关重要的作用：轴对齐的边缘状态保持无间隙，而对角边缘获得具有交替符号的有效质量，从而产生位于质量域壁处的四个角模式。通过投影到边缘状态子空间，我们得出不同边界几何形状的有效边缘哈密顿量。此外，在周期性边界条件下引入的 π 磁通缺陷会产生位于磁通核心处的零能量束缚态，为没有物理边界的非平凡拓扑提供了补充证据。
abstract: arXiv:2611.13438v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that proximity to a dₓy-wave altermagnet provides an effective route to engineering boundary-geometry-dependent higher-order topological phases. The boundary geometry plays a crucial role in determining the topological properties: axis-aligned edge states remain gapless, whereas diagonal edges acquire effective masses with alternating signs, giving rise to four corner modes localized at the mass domain walls. By projecting onto the edge-state subspace, we derive the effective edge Hamiltonians for different boundary geometries. Furthermore, π-flux defects introduced under periodic boundary conditions yield zero-energy bound states localized at the flux cores, providing complementary evidence for nontrivial topology without physical boundaries. The interplay between the Zeeman field and the altermagnetic order drives a topological transition through the closing and reopening of the edge gap, while the bulk gap remains open. These findings highlight the crucial role of boundary geometry in higher-order topology and establish proximity-induced dₓy-wave altermagnetism as a route to engineering higher-order topological phases.

title: Hybridization-brightened interlayer excitons in multilayer WSe2 controlled by sliding ferroelectricity
title_zh: 滑动铁电控制多层 WSe2 中的杂化增亮层间激子
summary: 层间激子（IX）将空间分离的电子和空穴波函数与电可调偶极矩结合在一起，但它们减少的波函数重叠通常会限制光发射，特别是对于高能态。在这里，我们报告了少层 WSe2 中接近 2.23 eV 的明亮、光谱窄的高能层间激子 (h-IX)，并研究了其光学活性如何随层数和滑动铁电极化而演变。在原始的 2H-WSe2 中，我们观察到高能激子发射的厚度依赖性增亮。 GW-BSE 计算揭示了混合的层内和层间结构，具有增强的光学重量，表明多层杂化有助于观察到的增亮。
abstract: arXiv:2611.13264v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Interlayer excitons (IXs) combine spatially separated electron and hole wavefunctions with electrically tunable dipole moments, but their reduced wavefunction overlap generally limits optical emission, particularly for high-energy states. Here we report a bright, spectrally narrow high-energy interlayer exciton (h-IX) near 2.23 eV in few-layer WSe2 and investigate how its optical activity evolves with layer number and sliding-ferroelectric polarization. In pristine 2H-WSe2, we observe thickness-dependent brightening of high-energy exciton emission. GW-BSE calculations reveal mixed intralayer and interlayer configurations with enhanced optical weight, suggesting that multilayer hybridization contributes to the observed brightening. In parallel-stacked 3L/3L WSe2 containing a sliding-ferroelectric interface, the h-IX exhibits polarization-dependent energies and Stark responses that distinguish Pup and Pdown domains. Electric-field-driven domain-wall motion produces hysteretic transfer of spectral weight between the two h-IX branches, enabling optical tracking of ferroelectric switching. These results establish multilayer hybridization as a route to optically active high-energy interlayer excitons and sliding ferroelectricity as a complementary degree of freedom for controlling their energy, dipole and emission.

title: A Perspective on Topological Charge Density Wave Materials
title_zh: 拓扑电荷密度波材料的展望
summary: 电荷密度波是量子材料中最早已知的有序态之一，但它们已重新出现在现代拓扑、对称破缺和集体动力学讨论的中心。在几种材料类别中，电荷密度波序以引发拓扑解释的方式重塑电子能带、边界态、缺陷结构和电磁响应。真实空间成像表明，不相称的阶数可以形成相位缺陷网络，而不是均匀调制。边界分辨光谱揭示了间隙内模式，其存在和空间结构跟踪电荷密度波顺序，尽管此类观察仍然局限于单一材料族。在韦尔材料中，密度波间隙与类轴子磁电响应相关，将电荷密度波相位置于有效作用的动态场描述中。
abstract: arXiv:2611.13360v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Charge density waves are among the earliest known ordered states in quantum materials, yet they have re-emerged at the center of modern discussions of topology, symmetry breaking, and collective dynamics. In several material classes, charge-density-wave order reshapes electronic bands, boundary states, defect structures, and electromagnetic responses in ways that invite a topological interpretation. Real-space imaging has shown that incommensurate order can form networks of phase defects rather than uniform modulations. Boundary-resolved spectroscopy has revealed in-gap modes whose existence and spatial structure track the charge-density-wave order, although such observations remain confined to a single material family. In Weyl materials, density-wave gaps have been linked to axion-like magnetoelectric response, placing the charge-density-wave phase within a dynamical-field description of the effective action. In kagome metals, charge order is intertwined with Berry curvature, unconventional symmetry breaking, and superconductivity. These developments have led to the term "topological charge density wave," but the phrase describes several physically distinct phenomena. We distinguish three meanings: (i) topology of the order parameter and its defects, (ii) topology of the charge-density-wave-reconstructed electronic structure and its boundary modes, and (iii) axion-like electromagnetic response generated by density-wave order. The experimental and theoretical support for these three meanings differs substantially. This Perspective traces the development of these ideas, clarifies the evidence behind each class, identifies unresolved questions and points of debate, and outlines experimental criteria for establishing topology in charge-density-wave states.

title: Barriers to dequantization of near-term molecular electronic structure methods
title_zh: 近期分子电子结构方法反量子化的障碍
summary: 我们在广义 mathsfP≠mathsfNP 猜想下证明了量子电路系列在近期分子电子基态和激发态估计中的应用的经典模拟难度。该证明利用了与具有费米魔态输入的粒子数守恒匹配门电路的连接，这些电路被证明对于后选择下的量子计算是通用的，因此在最坏的情况下，无论是在强（乘法）还是弱（采样）意义上，都不能进行经典模拟。
abstract: arXiv:2503.21041v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We prove classical simulation hardness, under the generalized mathsfP≠mathsfNP conjecture, for quantum circuit families with applications in near-term molecular electronic ground and excited state estimation. The proof exploits a connection to particle number conserving matchgate circuits with fermionic magic state inputs, which are shown to be universal for quantum computation under postselection, and are therefore not classically simulable in the worst case, in either the strong (multiplicative) or weak (sampling) sense. We apply these results to non-orthogonal quantum eigensolvers designed for near-term hardware by ruling out sample-based dequantization strategies to additively approximate the off-diagonal matrix elements between orbital-rotated correlated reference states that satisfy an irreducible fermionic magic property, which combines anticoncentration in any orbital basis with an average-case multiplicative approximation hardness conjecture for the associated matrix polynomials. We apply this complexity analysis to two choices of ansatz that incorporate both static and dynamic correlations to model the electronic eigenstates of molecular systems. These are linear combinations of orbital-rotated matrix product states, which are preparable in linear depth, and linear combinations of states prepared by generalized unitary coupled cluster with singles and doubles or unitary cluster Jastrow circuits of polynomial depth, for which computing the expectation values of local fermionic observables up to a constant additive error is mathsfBQP-complete. We discuss the implications for achieving practical quantum advantage in resolving the electronic structure of catalytic systems composed from multivalent transition metal atoms using near-term quantum hardware.

title: Chiral Superconductivity Indifferent to Parent Topology in the Square-Lattice Hofstadter-Hubbard Model
title_zh: 方晶格 Hofstadter-Hubbard 模型中的手性超导性与母体拓扑无关
summary: 我们研究了一种 π 通量方格 t-t' Hofstadter-Hubbard 模型，该模型建议可在扭曲莫尔双层中实现。通过在半填充时调整 U 和 t'，基态密度矩阵重整化群模拟 (DMRG) 和部分子分析识别出相图中的整数量子霍尔 (IQH) 相、手性自旋液体 (CSL) 和反铁磁体 (AFM)，而有限温度行列式量子蒙特卡罗 (DQMC) 的电荷和自旋波动表明电荷能隙闭合，但 IQH-CSL 边界处的自旋能隙开放，与拓扑一致预计那里会有临界点。
abstract: arXiv:2611.13091v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a π-flux square-lattice t-t' Hofstadter-Hubbard model proposed to be realizable in twisted moiré bilayers. By tuning U and t' at half filling, ground-state density-matrix renormalization group simulations (DMRG) and a parton analysis identify an integer quantum Hall (IQH) phase, a chiral spin liquid (CSL), and an antiferromagnet (AFM) in the phase diagram, while charge and spin fluctuations from finite-temperature determinant quantum Monte Carlo (DQMC) suggest a closing charge gap but an open spin gap at the IQH-CSL boundary, consistent with the topological criticality expected there. This model therefore produces a phase diagram hosting weakly correlated band topology (IQH), intrinsic topological order (CSL), and conventional symmetry breaking (AFM) side by side. Upon doping any of these three parent phases, a single chiral topological superconductor with spin Chern number Cₛ=-2 occupies nearly the entire phase diagram. DMRG, DQMC, and weak-coupling perturbation theory agree on its pairing symmetry. This shows that doping the topological band of our model robustly induces the same paired state throughout the phase diagram regardless of the character of the underlying correlated half-filled state and its magnetic fluctuations, whether an IQH, a spin liquid or a weakly fluctuating AFM.

title: Dynamical Casimir emission from Floquet-driven Landau polaritons: Gauge invariance forbids a superradiant phase transition
title_zh: Floquet 驱动的朗道极化子的动态卡西米尔发射：规范不变性禁止超辐射相变
summary: 线性系统的超强光-物质耦合，例如太赫兹腔中二维电子气形成的朗道极化子，由玻色霍普菲尔德模型描述，并且规范不变性禁止超辐射相变（SRPT）。据预测，单独调制磁场可以增强循环平均耦合并引发 Floquet SRPT。我们开发了周期性驱动朗道极化子的精确理论。包括调制通量（法拉第定律）感应的电场，根据科恩定理，问题精确地简化为耦合到腔的电子质心模式，其哈密顿量是每个时刻的平方和。
abstract: arXiv:2611.14339v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ultrastrong light--matter coupling of linear systems, such as Landau polaritons formed by a two-dimensional electron gas in a terahertz cavity, is described by the bosonic Hopfield model, and gauge invariance forbids a superradiant phase transition (SRPT). Modulating the magnetic field alone has been predicted to enhance the cycle-averaged coupling and induce a Floquet SRPT. We develop an exact theory of periodically driven Landau polaritons. Including the electric field induced by the modulated flux (Faraday's law), the problem reduces exactly, by Kohn's theorem, to the electronic center-of-mass mode coupled to the cavity, whose Hamiltonian is a sum of squares at every instant. A theorem of Krein then guarantees stability to all orders above a computable drive frequency, the Krein frequency, for which we give a self-contained proof. Below it, the system is stable except within resonance tongues where the drive creates pairs from the vacuum, the dynamical Casimir effect. At high drive frequency the electrons experience the mean field plus a ponderomotive trap (the Fock--Darwin problem), not an enhanced coupling. A gauge theorem excludes a Floquet photon condensate for any band structure, including Kane nonparabolicity, for which we derive a generalized Thomas--Reiche--Kuhn (TRK) sum rule. The predicted transition arises from averaging the coupling in a fixed Landau-level basis, which yields an effective model that violates the TRK sum rule; under driving, gauge invariance also requires the induced Faraday field. The rule to modulate and average the minimal-coupling Hamiltonian, not the parameters of its projection, applies to any linear, minimally coupled system. Instead of an SRPT, magnetic modulation produces dynamical Casimir emission: Faraday-driven polariton--magnetoplasmon pairs at low threshold, and two-color photon pairs with up to 5--10~dB of two-mode squeezing.

title: Local electronic structure of the Co2+ ions in the disordered perovskite phase of Ba3CoNb2O9: a temperature-dependent X-ray absorption and magnetic circular dichroism study
title_zh: Ba3CoNb2O9 无序钙钛矿相中 Co2+ 离子的局域电子结构：温度依赖性 X 射线吸收和磁圆二色性研究
summary: 我们对 Ba₃CoNb2O₉ 的无序相进行了温度依赖性 X 射线吸收光谱 (XAS) 和 X 射线磁圆二色性 (XMCD) 测量，以确定 Co2+ 离子的局域电子结构。我们采用线拟合逆部分荧光产率（iPFY）方法从这种绝缘材料中获得可靠的光谱。通过比较实验光谱和完整的多重态簇计算，我们能够限制局部晶体场环境并评估 Co²⁺ 基态的自旋轨道纠缠性质。在这个化学无序系统中，Co²⁺ 离子平均保留有效的立方晶体场环境，支持 J_eff = 1/2 基态。
abstract: arXiv:2611.14072v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We performed temperature-dependent X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) and X-ray magnetic circular dichroism (XMCD) measurements on the disordered phase of Ba₃CoNb₂O₉ to determine the local electronic structure of the Co²⁺ ions. We employed the line-fitting inverse partial fluorescence yield (iPFY) method to obtain reliable spectra from this insulating material. From the comparison between the experimental spectra and full multiplet cluster calculations we were able to constrain the local crystal-field environment and assess the spin-orbit-entangled nature of the Co²⁺ ground state. In this chemically disordered system, the Co²⁺ ions retain on average an effectively cubic crystal-field environment that supports a J_eff = 1/2 ground state. These results further establish that Ba₃CoNb₂O₉ is a promising platform for investigating the effect of disorder on J_eff = 1/2 magnetism.

title: Particle-hole asymmetry and a fluctuating pair-density-wave state in a lightly doped Mott insulator on the square lattice
title_zh: 方晶格上轻掺杂莫特绝缘体中的粒子孔不对称性和波动对密度波态
summary: 方形晶格上的轻掺杂莫特绝缘体是否支持鲁棒的 d 波超导仍然是强相关物理学和铜酸盐超导微观理论的中心问题。实验和数值研究揭示了明显的粒子空穴不对称性，表明 d 波超导性、对密度波 (PDW)、条纹、电荷密度波 (CDW) 和反铁磁相关性之间存在微妙的竞争。在这里，我们结合大规模 DMRG 和有限尺寸 PEPS 来研究低掺杂（δ ≤ 0.1）下的方晶格 t-J 模型，同时将近邻跳跃 t' 从类电子（t'>0）调整为类空穴（t'<0）状态。
abstract: arXiv:2611.14101v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Whether a lightly doped Mott insulator on the square lattice supports robust d-wave superconductivity remains a central question in strongly correlated physics and in the microscopic theory of cuprate superconductivity. Experiments and numerical studies reveal a pronounced particle-hole asymmetry, pointing to a delicate competition among d-wave superconductivity, pair-density wave (PDW), stripe, charge-density wave (CDW), and antiferromagnetic correlations. Here we combine large-scale DMRG and finite-size PEPS to study the square-lattice t-J model at low doping, δ ≤ 0.1, while tuning the next-nearest-neighbor hopping t' from the electron-like (t'>0) to the hole-like (t'<0) regime. The electron-like side supports robust, nearly uniform d-wave pairing, whereas decreasing t' induces a period-two plaquette modulation and ultimately produces, on the hole-like side, a charge-dominated state with a strongly suppressed static pairing amplitude. DMRG calculations on open strips and squares, together with PEPS calculations on open squares up to 16×16 sites, support this evolution. On squares with C₄-symmetric Hamiltonians, both methods find that the pair correlations of the hole-like state select the plaquette momenta (π,0) and (0,π) and decay within a few lattice spacings, while the dominant charge-density modulation forms a bidirectional checkerboard whose period extrapolates to about 4a₀, close to that observed in lightly doped Bi-2201. These observations establish a fluctuating plaquette PDW in the lightly doped hole-like regime, in which local pairs carry finite momentum but lack phase coherence. Our results firmly establish particle-hole asymmetry as a central organizing principle for competing pairing tendencies in the lightly doped t-J model.

title: Phase transitions in the simplicial Ising model on hypergraphs
title_zh: 超图上的单纯 Ising 模型中的相变
summary: 复杂的高阶相互作用可以重塑复杂系统中的高阶动力学。对高阶相互作用可以触发的相变的系统理解仍然不完整。在这里，我们研究超图上的单纯伊辛模型中的相变，其中只有当所有成员自旋一致对齐时，每个超边内的能量才会降低。我们证明它的哈密顿量相当于低阶相互作用的加权和，并使用朗道自由能根据超边尺寸来识别不同的相变。对于 q 均匀超图，在三临界点 q = 4 处，跃迁的性质从连续转变为不连续。当成对边和大小 q > 2 的超边共存时，会出现不同的情况，包括混合阶和双跃迁（对于 q > 8）。
abstract: arXiv:2411.19080v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Complex higher-order interactions can reshape higher-order dynamics in complex systems. Systematic understanding of the repertoire of phase transitions that higher-order interactions can trigger remains incomplete. Here we study the phase transitions in the simplicial Ising model on hypergraphs, in which the energy within each hyperedge is lowered only when all the member spins are unanimously aligned. We show that its Hamiltonian is equivalent to a weighted sum of lower-order interactions and use the Landau free energy to identify diverse phase transitions depending on the hyperedge sizes. For q-uniform hypergraphs, the nature of transitions shifts from continuous to discontinuous at the tricritical point q = 4. When both pairwise edges and hyperedges of size q > 2 coexist, diverse scenarios emerge, including mixed-order and double transitions, for q > 8. We further adopt the Bethe--Peierls method to investigate the interplay between pairwise and higher-order interactions in achieving global magnetization, illuminating the multiscale nature of double transitions.

title: Time Direction Entanglement Entropy of Free Fermion Ground States
title_zh: 自由费米子基态的时间方向纠缠熵
summary: 虽然空间子区域的纠缠熵已被广泛研究，但时间方向间隔中量子态的正确定义的纠缠熵仍未得到充分探索。我们研究了最近定义的自由费米子量子态的时间方向纠缠熵（TDEE）的缩放行为，该熵是根据子希尔伯特空间的约简密度矩阵计算得出的，该空间最低限度地支持时间方向间隔中的所有时间演化算子。基于 Toeplitz 矩阵的 Fisher--Hartwig 猜想，我们开发了一个分析框架，用于理解具有离散时间步长 τ 的时间间隔内的 TDEE。
abstract: arXiv:2611.13085v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: While the entanglement entropy of a spatial subregion has been extensively studied, a properly defined entanglement entropy of quantum states in a time direction interval remains underexplored. We investigate the scaling behaviors of the recently defined time direction entanglement entropy (TDEE) for free fermion quantum states, which is computed from the reduced density matrix of a sub-Hilbert space that minimally supports all the time-evolved operators in the time direction interval. Based on the Fisher--Hartwig conjecture for Toeplitz matrices, we develop an analytical framework for understanding the TDEE in a time interval with discrete time step τ. For disorderless one-dimensional (1D) systems (gapless fermions or band insulators), in different regimes of gap, bandwidth and τ, we find the TDEE can exhibit area law (for nonzero gap), logarithmic law or volume law in the length of time. For 1D Anderson insulators, we numerically find the TDEE shows a Page-curve like behavior, growing at short time, and decaying in power-law at long time exceeding the crossover time determined by localization. In the continuum time limit τ→ 0, the TDEE of disorderless gapless fermions, band insulators and Anderson insulators exhibit logarithmic law, area law and sub-area law, respectively. We also show that the sub-Hilbert space of a time-direction interval stabilizes in the τ→ 0 limit, which is understandable as a subspace of the Hilbert space of the Lieb-Robinson causal diamond.
